name_vi: Túi vệ sinh du lịch treo mở
description_en: A folding woven-and-textile toiletry case with a hanging hook, three empty lined pouches and top zipper. Canonical front: the broad front woven panel and zipper pull. Side view: the layered pouch thickness and folding hinge bands. Rear view: a plain textile backing with the recessed hanging hook. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A folding woven-and-textile toiletry case with a hanging hook, three empty lined pouches and top zipper. Canonical front: the broad front woven panel and zipper pull. Side view: the layered pouch thickness and folding hinge bands. Rear view: a plain textile backing with the recessed hanging hook. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Modern: clean contemporary geometry. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
